    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if not row or row[0] == row[-1]:
            continue
        end = len(row) - 1
        color = row[-1]
        while end >= 0 and row[end] == color:
            out[r][end] = 1
            end -= 1
    return out
'''
